layout.--font-ui: 'Microsoft YaHei', '微软雅黑', Tahoma, Arial, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', sans-serif

aqua-dark.--gradient-button: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent-soft)) 54%, black) 0%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 50%, white) 45%, black) 48%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 60%, white) 45%, black) 52%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 55%, white) 50%, black) 100% )
aqua-dark.--gradient-button-hover: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 55%, white) 60%, black), color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 55%, white) 50%, black) )
aqua-dark.--gradient-button-primary: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 74%, white) 0%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, white) 85%, black) 48%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, white) 75%, black) 52%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, white) 60%, black) 100% )
aqua-dark.--gradient-header: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 70%, white) 85%, black) 0%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, white) 80%, black) 48%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 85%, white) 65%, black) 52%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 95%, white) 60%, black) 100% )
aqua-dark.--gradient-panel-title: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent-soft)) 52%, black) 0%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 55%, white) 40%, black) 100% )
aqua-dark.--terminal-selection: color-mix( in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent)) 60%, white) 35%, transparent )

aqua-light.--gradient-button: linear-gradient( 180deg, hsl(var(--surface)) 0%, hsl(var(--background)) 48%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 16%, white) 52%, hsl(var(--background)) 100% )
aqua-light.--gradient-button-hover: linear-gradient( 180deg, hsl(var(--surface)), hsl(var(--surface-hover)) 50%, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent-soft)) 38%, white) 100% )
aqua-light.--gradient-button-primary: linear-gradient( 180deg, hsl(var(--accent-soft)) 0%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, white) 48%, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent-strong)) 91%, white) 52%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 95%, white) 75%, black) 100% )
aqua-light.--gradient-header: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent-soft)) 74%, white) 0%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 70%, white) 45%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 85%, white) 90%, black) 55%, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 95%, white) 80%, black) 100% )
aqua-light.--gradient-panel-title: linear-gradient( 180deg, hsl(var(--surface)) 0%, hsl(var(--background)) 50%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 16%, white) 100% )
aqua-light.--terminal-selection: color-mix( in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent)) 67%, white) 35%, transparent )

day.--gradient-button-hover: linear-gradient( 180deg, hsl(var(--surface)), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 17%, white) )
day.--gradient-button-primary: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 74%, white), var(--primary) )
day.--gradient-header: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 74%, white), var(--primary) )
day.--gradient-panel-title: linear-gradient( 180deg, hsl(var(--background)), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 17%, white) )
day.--terminal-selection: color-mix( in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent)) 74%, white) 35%, transparent )

dim.--gradient-button: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 58%, black), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 49%, black) )
dim.--gradient-button-hover: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 62%, black), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 53%, black) )
dim.--gradient-button-primary: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent-strong)) 80%, white), hsl(var(--accent-strong)) )
dim.--gradient-header: linear-gradient( 180deg, hsl(var(--accent-strong)), color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent-strong)) 74%, black) )
dim.--gradient-panel-title: linear-gradient( 180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 57%, black), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 47%, black) )
dim.--terminal-selection: color-mix( in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent)) 79%, white) 35%, transparent )

sandstone-dark.--gradient-button-primary: linear-gradient( 0deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 91%, white), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 91%, white) )
sandstone-dark.--terminal-selection: color-mix( in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent)) 91%, white) 28%, transparent )

sandstone-light.--gradient-button-primary: linear-gradient( 0deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 93%, white), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 93%, white) )
sandstone-light.--terminal-selection: color-mix( in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent)) 85%, white) 32%, transparent )

tgreen-dark.--gradient-button-hover: linear-gradient( 0deg, color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 45%, white) 30%, black), color-mix(in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 45%, white) 30%, black) )

tgreen-light.--terminal-selection: color-mix( in oklch, color-mix(in oklch, hsl(var(--accent-soft)) 93%, white) 28%, transparent )
